integrity.primary_formula_basis: Kleiman's duality section identifies the top Segre-class formula and states nondefectiveness for nonlinear complete intersections.
integrity.source_date_basis: A bibliographic record for Kleiman's chapter gives 1977-01-01 as the publication date.

scientific_limitations: The theorem determines the first 2-adic layer, not the full valuation after the first extra factor of two.
The variety must be smooth, positive-dimensional, nonlinear, and a complete intersection in the stated embedding.
An unindexed classical source could contain the same arithmetic corollary.
title: Two-adic first-layer law for dual degrees of smooth complete intersections
